title: Solar AI ground-level PV defect research v1
subtitle: Class-normalized YOLOv8 ground-level PV defect detection dataset (panel / bird_drop / cracked / dusty)
description:
Solar AI ground-level PV defect research dataset.

This is a class-normalized, audited repackaging of a publicly available Roboflow Universe dataset for RESEARCH / non-commercial use. Solar AI did NOT create the underlying photographs.

Source dataset:
  Susan. "panel solar Dataset." Roboflow Universe.
  https://universe.roboflow.com/susan-ifblr/panel-solar-bw945
  workspace/project/version: susan-ifblr / panel-solar-bw945 / 1
  export format: YOLOv8

License: CC BY 4.0, as displayed by the source on Roboflow. Attribution preserved. Image-level provenance of individual photographs is NOT independently verified (see the audit report shipped with this dataset).

Classes (canonical research taxonomy, fixed id order):
  0 = panel      (individual solar-panel boundary)
  1 = bird_drop  (bird-dropping contamination region)
  2 = cracked    (crack / physical-damage region)
  3 = dusty      (dust / soiling region)

Hotspot is deliberately excluded: RGB photographs cannot validate thermal-hotspot semantics.

Contents: images/ + labels/ + data.yaml (Ultralytics format), plus the Solar AI dataset audit report (dataset_audit.md / dataset_audit.json) and NORMALIZATION.json documenting the source->research class-id remap. The official train/valid/test split is preserved; a leakage-clean split is included only if the audit found cross-split duplicate leakage.

Intended use: training a research-grade ground-level PV visual defect detector, evaluated separately. Not a validated engineering or safety diagnosis.
